scope: Proposition 5.12 (Coxeter compatibility and ordered galleries) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 47. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The permutation p preserves the Coxeter matrix. Along a source chamber gallery, the ordered product of the chamber PVMs is supported on target galleries of the permuted type, allowing stutters. More precisely, smooth functions vanishing on that target gallery manifold annihilate the ordered product, with arbitrary smooth multipliers. At finite places the corresponding assertion holds for locally constant tests by compact clopen partitions.
